{{Top|leg}}
'''Jatras''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who specialized in turning in live [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]. Jatras owned a suit of [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|Cresh Luck armor]], and as the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] had a warning system based on a noise. Jatras disliked the item, because the noise would either warn the attacker as well, or alternatively prevent Jatras from locating the attacker using hearing. Jatras posted about this problem in [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], and a person named [[Heller]] suggested to replace the noise-based warning using the "[[tingler]]" of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].
